root_cause: Merge-group event normalizer used an Actions run ID as prNumber instead of null, allowing PR-specific flows to mistake a merge-group execution for a PR. The hygiene admission did not independently compare checkout SHA against merge_group.head_sha.
prevention_rule: Never infer PR number from workflow run ID. Require provider-supplied merge_group.head_sha to equal immutable GitHub Actions SHA and checkout SHA; emit empty PR output. Required, CodeQL and admission remain fail closed.

canary: Native organization-owned one-candidate queue pilot after authorized transfer
invariants: no Actions run ID as PR
no additional schedule, agent or registry
